name: cron_list
description: List schedules read-only: user crontab, /etc/crontab + cron.d, cron.{hourly..monthly} names, systemd timers

user_only.description: only the user's crontab (default false: also system cron, periodic dirs and systemd timers)

path.description: parse this crontab-format file instead of querying the system (max 1 MB)

format.description: with path: user lines (default) or system lines with a user field like /etc/crontab
